tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Find open government datasets and census maps about a topic in a place, across hundreds of national, state and city data portals. Returns each dataset's licence (with how sure it is), whether Vizzie can map it, and a link to open it in Vizzie; census topics come first as ready-made map links. The pl

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description: What a dataset from search_datasets contains: each column's meaning, type, role and unit, its licence, and the boundaries it joins to. Takes the result's `ref` unchanged.

tools.name: resolve_geography
tools.description: Given a column of area codes (e.g. LSOA, SA2, census tract, LGA, NUTS), say which geography level and vintage they are, what share match, and whether Vizzie can provide the boundaries. Checks every code, not a sample.

tools.name: get_boundaries
tools.description: Boundary polygons as GeoJSON for a list of area codes or a bounding box, at a named level (from resolve_geography). Only for boundaries whose licence lets Vizzie pass them on; attribution included. Capped at 2,000 areas per call; create_map draws data on a map without transferring geometry.

tools.name: get_catchment
tools.description: The catchment around an address or a set of points or shapes: everywhere within a straight-line distance, or an isochrone — how far you can walk or drive along roads. Returns the polygons as GeoJSON (one per origin, or merged) and a map_url that opens the catchment in Vizzie. Up to 10 km (5 mi).

tools.name: create_map
tools.description: Make a map someone can open in Vizzie with one link, and that edit_map can change afterwards. source "census": a census topic for a place. source "rows": your own table of area codes and values, joined to boundaries (the geography is worked out from the codes if you leave it out) — up to 5,000 rows,

tools.name: save_map
tools.description: Keep a map made with create_map in the person's Vizzie account, so it doesn't expire after 30 days and is listed on their projects page. It counts as one of their plan's projects. Needs the person to sign in to Vizzie (free); the first call starts the sign-in.

tools.name: edit_map
tools.description: Change a map already made with create_map, in place — same link, and a Vizzie window with it open redraws within seconds. tools.name: publish_map
tools.description: Save a map made with create_map and get publish_url: it opens the map in Vizzie, signed in, with the publish dialog open, so one click gives a public link to share. Needs the person to sign in to Vizzie (free).
